constraint_candidates.formula_text: For each target_id: sum(x[e]) <= max_attempts_per_target, where max_attempts_per_target = 1.
For each radar_id: sum(x[e]) <= public radar channel_capacity.
For each launcher_id: sum(x[e]) <= public launcher inventory/capacity.

For repeated attempts on the same target, enforce ripple_hit_separation_s lower/upper using hit_step and public time step; enforce same_radar_when_separation_below_s. Note max_attempts_per_target=1 makes repeated-attempt branches vacuous in this case.

forbidden_data_boundaries: {'boundary': 'hidden/reference/trusted-builder artifacts', 'path_pattern': 'trusted_evaluation/**', 'reason': 'Restricted source root; no hidden reference or trusted builder artifacts may be read.'}
{'boundary': 'hidden/reference answer key', 'path_pattern': '**/answer_key*', 'reason': 'Non-public answer-key fields are forbidden.'}
{'boundary': 'reference solution', 'path_pattern': '**/reference_solution*', 'reason': 'No reference solution may be used.'}

{'boundary': 'external evaluator feedback', 'path_pattern': 'public_benchmark_execution_contract.evaluation_objective_vector_contract.objectives[0].replay_source_paths[0]', 'reason': 'Evaluator replay path is not materialized and must not be read during planning.'}

{'boundary': 'non-public raw probability or hidden benchmark skeleton', 'path_pattern': '**/hidden*/**', 'reason': 'Non-public raw probability, hidden model, or benchmark skeleton fields are forbidden.'}

builder_directives: Implement only the Planner-approved modeling level: time_indexed_public.
Do not introduce variables or constraints for unsupported constructs listed in forbidden_modeling_constructs.
Use only public input fields and executable_data_manifest-allowed paths.
Use sparse public candidate variables x[e] instead of dense Cartesian expansion.
Do not create independent launch_time or launch_step decision variables.
Use solver objective contract madra.value_weighted_interception: maximize sum target_value[e] * interception_probability[e] for selected engagements.
Preserve solution_view contract fields and objective replay metadata.
